def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2,8) for v in row))
    for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
        if v in (2,8):
            h=4 if v==2 else 3
            for d in range(1,min(h,r+1)+1):

    return out
